title: Ish va o‘qish hayoti
goal_uz: Dars oxirida kasbingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapira olasiz: qayerda ishlashingiz yoki o‘qishingiz, mas’uliyatlaringiz (have to, responsible for), odatiy kuningiz va nimani yoqtirishingiz yoki yoqtirmasligingiz.

scenes.title: Ish va o‘qish hayoti haqida
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we will talk about work and study life. By the end, you will describe your job or your studies for one minute.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda mehmonxona va sayohatda kerak bo‘ladigan iboralarni o‘rgandik: xona band qilish, yo‘l so‘rash. Bugun esa har kuni boradigan joyingiz, ya’ni ishxona yoki o‘quv yurti haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida bir daqiqa davomida ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida gapira olasiz: nima qilasiz, nimaga mas’ulsiz, kuningiz qanday o‘tadi va nimani yoqtirasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! Bugun ish va o‘qish hayoti haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida bir daqiqa gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Kasblar
board: a teacher, a nurse, a driver
scenes.say: A teacher works at a school. A nurse works in a hospital. An engineer designs machines. An accountant works with numbers.
scenes.say_native: Avval kasblar. Teacher o‘qituvchi, nurse hamshira, driver haydovchi, engineer muhandis, accountant buxgalter, shop assistant sotuvchi, manager menejer. Diqqat qiling: inglizchada kasb nomidan oldin a yoki an qo‘yiladi. O‘zbekchada “Men o‘qituvchiman” deymiz, inglizchada esa “I’m a teacher”. Unli tovush bilan boshlansa an: an engineer, an accountant. Gap shunday yodda qolsin: kasb ham sanaladigan ot.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi maktabda ishlaydi. Hamshira kasalxonada ishlaydi. Muhandis mashinalarni loyihalaydi. Buxgalter raqamlar bilan ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Ish joyi va odamlar
board: boss / manager = the person in charge
scenes.say: My colleagues are friendly. Our manager is very helpful. Customers come to the shop all day.
scenes.say_native: Endi ish joylari va odamlar. Office ofis, factory zavod, hospital kasalxona, shop do‘kon, company kompaniya. Birga ishlaydigan odam bu colleague, hamkasb. Mijoz yoki xaridor customer. Rahbar boss yoki manager. Boss kundalik gapda, manager esa lavozim sifatida ko‘proq aytiladi. Colleague so‘zining o‘qilishi qiziq: “KOL-eeg”, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, oxiri “g” bilan.
scenes.say_uz: Hamkasblarim samimiy. Menejerimiz juda yordamchan. Mijozlar kun bo‘yi do‘konga kelishadi.

scenes.title: Qayerda va kim uchun ishlaysiz
board: I work in a bank / an office / a shop.
I work at a school / a hospital.
I work for a big company.

examples.t: She works for a big company.

scenes.say: I work as a nurse. I work in a hospital. I work for the city council.
scenes.say_native: Ishlash haqida gapirganda to‘rtta kichik so‘z kerak. Work as, ya’ni kim bo‘lib: I work as a driver. Work in, ichida: in a bank, in an office, in a shop. Work at, joyda: at a school, at a hospital. Work for, kim uchun: for a company, for my uncle. O‘zbekchada bularning hammasi bitta “-da ishlayman” bo‘lib ketadi, inglizchada esa har biri o‘z ma’nosiga ega. Yana: “I have a job” deymiz, lekin work ot bo‘lsa sanalmaydi: “I have work to do”.
scenes.say_uz: Men hamshira bo‘lib ishlayman. Kasalxonada ishlayman. Shahar hokimiyatida ishlayman.

scenes.title: Kasb va ishlash xatolari
board: ✗ I work teacher. / I work like a teacher.
✓ I'm a teacher. / I work as a teacher. / I work in a bank.
scenes.say: Not: I'm teacher. Say: I'm a teacher. Not: I work teacher. Say: I work as a teacher.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: a ni tushirib qoldirish, “I’m teacher”. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun bu juda tez-tez uchraydi. Ikkinchisi: “I work teacher” yoki “I work like a teacher”. To‘g‘risi “work as”. Like bu “…ga o‘xshab”, kasbni bildirmaydi. Uchinchisi: “on a bank”. Bank, office, shop bilan in ishlatamiz. Bu gaplarni bir marta ovoz chiqarib tuzatib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: I'm teacher emas, I'm a teacher deng. I work teacher emas, I work as a teacher deng.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang
board: 4) We work ___ a big company. (for / at)
scenes.say: Choose the correct word. Number one. Number two. Number three. Number four.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi gaplarda bo‘sh joyga to‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Birinchisi: u hamshira, is yoki works? Ikkinchisi: u haydovchi bo‘lib ishlaydi, as yoki in? Uchinchisi: men bankda ishlayman. To‘rtinchisi: biz katta kompaniya uchun ishlaymiz. Har bir gapni to‘liq, baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi. Ikkinchi. Uchinchi. To‘rtinchi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) We work for a big company.
scenes.say: She is a nurse. He works as a driver. I work in a bank. We work for a big company.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: she is a nurse, chunki kasbni aytyapmiz va bu yerda ish fe’li kerak emas. Ikkinchi: he works as a driver, as kasbni bildiradi. Uchinchi: I work in a bank, bank ichida. To‘rtinchi: we work for a big company, ya’ni kompaniya uchun. Agar to‘rttasini ham to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Xato qilsangiz, tuzatilgan gapni yana bir marta takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: U hamshira. U haydovchi bo‘lib ishlaydi. Men bankda ishlayman. Biz katta kompaniyada ishlaymiz.

scenes.title: O‘qish hayoti
board: a lesson, a subject, an exam, homework

examples.t: I take my exams in June.

scenes.say: I study law at university. I'm in my second year. I have exams in June and a lot of homework.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘qish. “Nimani o‘qiysiz?” deb What do you study? deymiz. Javob: I study law, I study medicine. Qayerda? At university, at school. Britaniya inglizchasida university oldidan artikl qo‘yilmaydi: I go to university. Kursni aytish uchun: I’m in my second year. Yana kerakli so‘zlar: subject fan, lesson dars, timetable dars jadvali, exam imtihon, homework uy vazifasi. Imtihon topshirish take an exam, o‘tish pass.
scenes.say_uz: Men universitetda huquqshunoslikni o‘qiyman. Ikkinchi kursdaman. Iyunda imtihonlarim bor va uy vazifasi ko‘p.

scenes.title: Majburiyat: have to
board: I / you / we / they + have to + verb
he / she / it + has to + verb

examples.t: I have to wear a uniform.
She has to start at eight.

scenes.say: I have to wear a uniform. She has to start at eight. We have to finish the report today.
scenes.say_native: Ish va o‘qishda ko‘p narsa majburiy: formada yurish, vaqtida kelish. Buning uchun have to ishlatamiz va keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi. I have to wear a uniform: men forma kiyishim kerak. He, she, it bilan has to: she has to start at eight. O‘zbekchada “-ishim kerak, -ishga majburman” deymiz. Have to odatda tashqaridan kelgan talabni bildiradi: ish joyining qoidasi, rahbar, jadval.
scenes.say_uz: Men forma kiyishim kerak. U sakkizda boshlashi kerak. Biz hisobotni bugun tugatishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol
board: I don't have to work on Sunday.
She doesn't have to wear a tie.
Do you have to work late?
Does he have to travel? – Yes, he does.

examples.t: She doesn't have to wear a tie.
Do you have to work late?

scenes.say: I don't have to work on Sundays. Do you have to work late? Yes, I do. Does he have to travel? No, he doesn't.
scenes.say_native: Inkor va savolda do va does yordam beradi. I don’t have to work on Sundays: yakshanba kuni ishlashim shart emas. Muhim ma’no: don’t have to bu “shart emas”, ya’ni ishlasangiz ham bo‘ladi, ishlamasangiz ham. Taqiqni anglatmaydi. Savol: Do you have to work late? Javob qisqa: Yes, I do yoki No, I don’t. Uchinchi shaxsda does: Does she have to travel? No, she doesn’t.
scenes.say_uz: Yakshanba kuni ishlashim shart emas. Kech ishlashingiz kerakmi? Ha. U sayohat qilishi kerakmi? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: have to dagi xatolar
board: ✗ Does she has to start early?
✗ I have to to go. / I must to go.
✓ She has to start early. Does she have to start early?
scenes.say: Not: she have to. Say: she has to. Not: does she has to. Say: does she have to.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: she have to. Uchinchi shaxs birlikda has to bo‘lishi shart. Ikkinchisi: does she has to. Does bor bo‘lsa, has emas, have qoladi, chunki does shaxs belgisini allaqachon olgan. Uchinchisi: have to to yoki must to. Have to dan keyin faqat bitta to bor, must dan keyin esa umuman to kerak emas. Ekrandagi to‘g‘ri gaplarni ketma-ket ayting.
scenes.say_uz: She have to emas, she has to deng. Does she has to emas, does she have to deng.

scenes.title: Gapni o‘zgartiring
board: 2) We ___ (not have to) work on Saturday.
4) My sister ___ (have to) study a lot.
scenes.say: Complete with have to or has to. Use the negative and the question where you need them.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi so‘zlar bilan gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: u kostyum kiyishi kerak. Ikkinchi: shanba kuni ishlashimiz shart emas, inkor shaklida. Uchinchi: siz soat yettida boshlashingiz kerakmi, savol shaklida. To‘rtinchi: singlim ko‘p o‘qishi kerak. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: have to yoki has to bilan to‘ldiring. Inkor va savolni kerakli joyda ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He has to wear a suit.
2) We don't have to work on Saturday.
3) Do you have to start at 7?
4) My sister has to study a lot.
scenes.say: He has to wear a suit. We don't have to work on Saturday. Do you have to start at seven? My sister has to study a lot.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: he has to wear a suit. Ikkinchi: we don’t have to work on Saturday, ya’ni shanba kuni ishlash shart emas. Uchinchi: do you have to start at seven, to‘rtinchi: my sister has to study a lot. Ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi gaplarni yana bir marta ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchisida has, to‘rtinchisida ham has, chunki he va my sister uchinchi shaxs.
scenes.say_uz: U kostyum kiyishi kerak. Shanba kuni ishlashimiz shart emas. Soat yettida boshlashingiz kerakmi? Singlim ko‘p o‘qishi kerak.

scenes.title: Mas’uliyat: responsible for
board: I look after / deal with / am in charge of

examples.t: She is in charge of the team.

scenes.say: I'm responsible for the shop's accounts. She's responsible for training new staff. He deals with customers.
scenes.say_native: Mas’uliyatingiz nima? Buni aytish uchun be responsible for ishlatamiz. For dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: I’m responsible for the accounts, she’s responsible for training new staff. Boshqa foydali iboralar: look after, ya’ni qarab turish, deal with, ya’ni muomala qilish yoki shug‘ullanish, be in charge of, ya’ni boshqarish. Masalan, he deals with customers: u mijozlar bilan shug‘ullanadi. Bular “mening vazifam” degan ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Men do‘kon hisob-kitoblariga mas’ulman. U yangi xodimlarni o‘qitishga mas’ul. U mijozlar bilan shug‘ullanadi.

scenes.title: responsible dagi xatolar
board: ✗ She is responsible to train staff.
✓ I'm responsible for the office / for training staff.
scenes.say: Not: responsible of. Say: responsible for. Not: responsible to train. Say: responsible for training.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: responsible of. O‘zbekcha “-ga mas’ul” sizga “of” ni eslatishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada doim for. Ikkinchisi: responsible to train. For dan keyin fe’l to bilan kelmaydi, -ing shaklida keladi: responsible for training. Uchinchisi: I responsible for sales. Bu yerda am tushib qolgan. Responsible sifat, shuning uchun oldidan am, is yoki are kerak. Gapni to‘g‘ri aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: Responsible of emas, responsible for deng. Responsible to train emas, responsible for training deng.

scenes.title: Mas’uliyatni ayting
scenes.say: Say what each person is responsible for.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir kasb egasi nimaga mas’ul ekanini gapda ayting. Birinchisi: haydovchi avtobusga. Ikkinchisi: o‘qituvchi bolalarni o‘qitishga, bu yerda for dan keyin -ing kerak. Uchinchisi: menejer jamoaga. To‘rtinchisi: qabulxona xodimi telefonga javob berishga. Har bir gapni responsible for bilan boshlang.
scenes.say_uz: Har kim nimaga mas’ul ekanini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) A driver is responsible for the bus.
2) A teacher is responsible for teaching children.
3) A manager is responsible for the team.
4) A receptionist is responsible for answering the phone.
scenes.say: A driver is responsible for the bus. A teacher is responsible for teaching children. A manager is responsible for the team. A receptionist is responsible for answering the phone.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Haydovchi avtobusga mas’ul, a driver is responsible for the bus. O‘qituvchi bolalarni o‘qitishga, teaching. Menejer jamoaga. Qabulxona xodimi, receptionist, telefonga javob berishga, answering the phone. Ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi gapda for dan keyin -ing borligiga e’tibor bering. Shu qolipni o‘z ishingiz uchun ham ishlatasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Haydovchi avtobusga mas’ul. O‘qituvchi bolalarni o‘qitishga mas’ul. Menejer jamoaga mas’ul. Qabulxona xodimi telefonga javob berishga mas’ul.

scenes.title: Dialog: ishingiz nima?
board: A: What do you do, Ben?
A: What are you responsible for?
B: The accounts. I also have to send invoices.
scenes.say: What do you do, Ben? I'm an accountant. I work for a small company in Leeds. What are you responsible for? I'm responsible for the company's accounts. I also have to send invoices to customers every month. Do you like it? Yes, but I don't like the deadlines. They are stressful.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki odam tanishmoqda, biri o‘z ishi haqida gapiradi. Uning kasbini, nimaga mas’ul ekanini, har oy nima qilishi kerakligini va nimani yoqtirmasligini eshiting. Savollarni oldindan o‘qib qo‘ying, so‘ng tinglang. Agar kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eshiting.
scenes.say_uz: Sen nima ish qilasan, Ben? Men buxgalterman. Lidsdagi kichik kompaniyada ishlayman. Nimaga mas’ulsan? Kompaniya hisob-kitoblariga mas’ulman. Har oy mijozlarga hisob-fakturalar yuborishim ham kerak. Yoqadimi? Ha, lekin muddatlar yoqmaydi. Ular asabiylashtiradi.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
board: 3) What does he have to do every month?
scenes.say: Four questions about Ben. Think about your answers.
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Benning kasbi nima? Ikkinchi: u nimaga mas’ul? Uchinchi: u har oy nima qilishi kerak? To‘rtinchi: unga nima yoqmaydi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan: Ben is an accountant. Agar eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana tinglang.
scenes.say_uz: Ben haqida to‘rtta savol. Javoblaringizni o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Ben is an accountant. He is responsible for the accounts. Every month he has to send invoices to customers. He doesn't like the deadlines.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ben buxgalter, he is an accountant. U kompaniya hisob-kitoblariga mas’ul. Har oy mijozlarga hisob-faktura yuborishi kerak, bu yerda have to ishlatilgan. Unga muddatlar, deadlines, yoqmaydi, chunki ular stressli. E’tibor bering, Ben o‘z ishini yomon demadi, faqat bir tomonini yoqtirmaydi. Ingliz tilida shunday muvozanatli gapirish tabiiy.
scenes.say_uz: Ben buxgalter. U hisob-kitoblarga mas’ul. Har oy mijozlarga hisob-faktura yuborishi kerak. Unga muddatlar yoqmaydi.

scenes.title: Odatiy ish kuni
board: I start work at 8.30. I finish at 5.
from 9 to 5 / at 8.30 / in the morning
at night, but in the afternoon

examples.t: I work from nine to five.

scenes.say: I start work at half past eight. I have a meeting at ten. I have lunch at one. I finish work at five and go home.
scenes.say_native: Odatiy kunni aytish uchun oddiy hozirgi zamon kerak, chunki bu doimiy odat. Foydali birikmalar: start work, finish work, have a meeting, answer emails, have lunch, have a break, go home. Vaqt bilan at: at half past eight. Kun qismlari bilan in: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening. Lekin at night. Ish vaqti: from nine to five, ya’ni to‘qqizdan beshgacha.
scenes.say_uz: Men sakkiz yarimda ishni boshlayman. O‘nda yig‘ilishim bor. Birda tushlik qilaman. Beshda ishni tugatib, uyga ketaman.

scenes.title: Ketma-ketlik so‘zlari
scenes.say: First I check my emails. Then I have a meeting. After that I write reports. Finally I go home.
scenes.say_native: Kuningizni tartib bilan aytish uchun bog‘lovchi so‘zlar kerak. First, avval. Then, keyin. After that, shundan keyin. Later, keyinroq. Finally, oxirida. Odatni bildirish uchun usually, odatda, often, tez-tez, sometimes, ba’zan. Bular odatda to‘ldiruvchi fe’ldan oldin turadi: I usually start at eight. Lekin be fe’lidan keyin: I am usually tired. Bu so‘zlar gapingizni bir-biriga ulaydi va nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Avval elektron xatlarimni tekshiraman. Keyin yig‘ilishim bor. Shundan keyin hisobotlar yozaman. Oxirida uyga ketaman.

scenes.title: Vaqt va odat xatolari
board: ✗ I go to work at the morning.
✗ I am starting work at 8 every day.
✓ I start work at 8 every day. I go to work in the morning.
scenes.say: Not: in eight o’clock. Say: at eight o’clock. Not: at the morning. Say: in the morning.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: in 8 o’clock. Aniq soat bilan doim at: at eight o’clock. Ikkinchisi: at the morning. Kun qismi bilan in kerak: in the morning. Uchinchisi: I am starting work at 8 every day. Har kungi odat uchun hozirgi davomli emas, oddiy hozirgi zamon kerak: I start work at 8. Hozirgi davomli zamonni keyingi darsda o‘rganamiz. Tuzatilgan gaplarni baland ovozda takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: In eight o’clock emas, at eight o’clock deng. At the morning emas, in the morning deng.

scenes.title: Hamshiraning kuni
board: She starts at 7 and finishes at 4.
scenes.say: My name is Dilya. I'm a nurse. I start work at seven in the morning. First I visit my patients. Then I give them their medicine. At twelve I have lunch with my colleagues. After that I write reports. I finish at four and go home by bus.
scenes.say_native: Endi bitta odam o‘z kunini hikoya qiladi. Uning kasbi, ish boshlash vaqti, tartib bilan qiladigan ishlari va uyga qanday qaytishi haqida gapiradi. Sizning ham o‘z kuningiz haqidagi hikoyangiz shunday tuziladi: kim, qachon boshlaydi, nima qiladi, qachon tugatadi. Tinglang va oldindan savollarga qarab qo‘ying.
scenes.say_uz: Mening ismim Dilya. Men hamshiraman. Ertalab yettida ishni boshlayman. Avval bemorlarimni ko‘raman. Keyin ularga dori beraman. O‘n ikkida hamkasblarim bilan tushlik qilaman. Shundan keyin hisobotlar yozaman. To‘rtda tugatib, avtobusda uyga ketaman.

scenes.title: Dilya haqida savollar
board: 3) Who does she have lunch with?
scenes.say: Four questions about Dilya's day. Answer in full sentences.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: u soat nechada boshlaydi? Ikkinchi: avval nima qiladi? Uchinchi: tushlikni kim bilan qiladi? To‘rtinchi: uyga qanday ketadi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe’lga s qo‘shishni unutmang: she starts, she visits.
scenes.say_uz: Dilyaning kuni haqida to‘rtta savol. To‘liq gaplar bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: She starts at seven. First she visits her patients. She has lunch with her colleagues. She goes home by bus.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. U ishni soat yettida boshlaydi: she starts at seven. Avval bemorlarni ko‘radi: she visits her patients. Tushlikni hamkasblari bilan qiladi: with her colleagues. Uyga avtobusda ketadi: by bus. Transport bilan by ishlatiladi: by bus, by car, by train. Lekin piyoda bo‘lsa, on foot deymiz. Fe’llarning oxiridagi s ga e’tibor bering: starts, visits, has, goes.
scenes.say_uz: U yettida boshlaydi. Avval bemorlarini ko‘radi. Tushlikni hamkasblari bilan qiladi. Uyga avtobusda ketadi.

scenes.title: Muhim so‘zlarning talaffuzi
scenes.say: Engineer. Colleague. Responsible. I have to go. She has to work.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda urg‘u muhim. Engineer so‘zida urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda: en-ji-NEER. Colleague da birinchi bo‘g‘inda: KOL-eeg. Responsible da ikkinchisida: ri-SPON-si-bl. Yana have to so‘zi tez nutqda “haf-tu” deb eshitiladi, chunki v tovushi keyingi t oldida jarangsiz f ga o‘tadi. Has to ham “has-tu” kabi. Uzun va aniq aytmang, bu tabiiy tezlikda yengil aytiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Muhandis. Hamkasb. Mas’ul. Men ketishim kerak. U ishlashi kerak.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni toping
board: 4) How do we say 'have to' fast?
scenes.say: Which syllable is stressed? Engineer. Colleague. Responsible.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir so‘zda urg‘u qaysi bo‘g‘inda ekanini o‘ylang va so‘zni baland ovozda ayting. Engineer, necha bo‘g‘inli va urg‘u qaysisida? Colleague, birinchi yoki ikkinchisida? Responsible, uch bo‘g‘indan qaysisida? Va to‘rtinchi savol: have to tez nutqda qanday eshitiladi? Javobingizni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘u qaysi bo‘g‘inda? Muhandis. Hamkasb. Mas’ul.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Engineer, third syllable. Colleague, first syllable. Responsible, second syllable. Have to sounds like haf-tu.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Engineer: uchinchi bo‘g‘in, en-ji-NEER. Colleague: birinchi bo‘g‘in, KOL-eeg. Responsible: ikkinchi bo‘g‘in, ri-SPON-si-bl. Have to tez nutqda haf-tu. Ona tilida urg‘u ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inda bo‘lgani uchun, inglizcha so‘zlarda ham oxiriga urg‘u bermang. Har bir yangi so‘zni yodlaganda urg‘usini ham yozib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Muhandis, uchinchi bo‘g‘in. Hamkasb, birinchi bo‘g‘in. Mas’ul, ikkinchi bo‘g‘in. Have to haf-tu kabi eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Yoqtirish va yoqtirmaslik
scenes.say: I enjoy working with children. I love my colleagues. I don't like getting up early. I hate writing reports.
scenes.say_native: Ishingizga munosabatni bildirish uchun like, love, enjoy, don’t like, hate ishlatamiz. Enjoy dan keyin faqat -ing shakli keladi: I enjoy teaching. Like va love dan keyin ham -ing yaxshi: I like working with people. Eng kuchli yoqtirmaslik hate. Yana I’m interested in, ya’ni qiziqaman, va my favourite part is, eng yoqtirgan qismim. O‘zbekchadagi “-ni yaxshi ko‘raman” aynan love ga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men bolalar bilan ishlashdan zavqlanaman. Hamkasblarimni yaxshi ko‘raman. Erta turishni yoqtirmayman. Hisobot yozishni yomon ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Tasvirlovchi so‘zlar va sabab
board: I like my job because it's interesting.
The best thing is ... / The worst thing is ...
scenes.say: I like my job because it's interesting. It's tiring, but it's well-paid. The worst thing is the traffic.
scenes.say_native: Fikringizni asoslash uchun because, chunki, ishlating. Sifatlar: interesting qiziqarli, boring zerikarli, stressful stressli, tiring charchatadigan, easy oson, difficult qiyin, well-paid yaxshi haq to‘lanadigan, flexible moslashuvchan jadvalli. Mukammal qolip: the best thing about my job is, ishimning eng yaxshi tomoni, va the worst thing is, eng yomon tomoni. But bilan ikki tomonni aytsangiz, nutqingiz boy bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Ishim menga yoqadi, chunki u qiziqarli. U charchatadi, lekin yaxshi haq to‘laydi. Eng yomon tomoni transport tiqilinchi.

scenes.title: Yoqtirish bilan bog‘liq xatolar
board: ✗ I like very much my job.
✓ I enjoy working here. I am bored at work. I like my job very much.
scenes.say: Not: I enjoy to work. Say: I enjoy working. Not: I am boring. Say: I am bored.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchisi: enjoy to work. Enjoy dan keyin faqat -ing. Ikkinchisi: I am boring. Boring bu zerikarli, ya’ni sizning o‘zingiz boshqalarni zeriktirasiz. Siz o‘zingiz zerikayotgan bo‘lsangiz, I am bored. Uchinchisi: I like very much my job. Inglizchada fe’l bilan to‘ldiruvchi orasiga very much qo‘yilmaydi, gap oxiriga qo‘yiladi: I like my job very much.
scenes.say_uz: I enjoy to work emas, I enjoy working deng. I am boring emas, I am bored deng.

scenes.title: Ikki variantdan birini tanlang
board: 3) The job is ___ but well-paid. (tiring / tired)
4) I like my job ___ it's interesting. (because / so)
scenes.say: Choose the correct word in each sentence. One, two, three, four.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘g‘ri variantni tanlang. Birinchi gapda ikkita bo‘shliq bor, film qanday va men qanday, boring yoki bored. Ikkinchi: enjoy dan keyin work yoki working. Uchinchi: ish qanday, tiring yoki tired. To‘rtinchi: sabab bildirish uchun because yoki so. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Bir, ikki, uch, to‘rt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The film is boring. I'm bored.
3) The job is tiring but well-paid.
4) I like my job because it's interesting.
scenes.say: The film is boring. I'm bored. I enjoy working with children. The job is tiring but well-paid. I like my job because it's interesting.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: the film is boring, I’m bored. Film o‘zi zerikarli, men esa zerikkanman. Ikkinchi: working. Uchinchi: tiring, ish charchatadi. Tired bo‘lsa, odam charchagan. To‘rtinchi: because, chunki so natija bildiradi, sabab emas. Sabab-natija farqini yodda tuting: sabab uchun because, natija uchun so. Ish va o‘qish haqida gapirganda bu sifatlar juda kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Film zerikarli. Men zerikkanman. Bolalar bilan ishlashdan zavqlanaman. Ish charchatadi, lekin yaxshi haq to‘laydi. Ishim menga yoqadi, chunki u qiziqarli.

scenes.title: Dialog: universitet hayoti
board: A: What do you study, Maria?
B: I study medicine. I'm in my second year.
B: Yes, but I love it.
scenes.say: What do you study, Maria? I study medicine at university. I'm in my second year. Is it difficult? Yes, it is. I have to study every evening and I have exams in June. But I love it. The lessons are really interesting. What is the worst part? Getting up early. My first class starts at eight!
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Tom talaba Mariyadan o‘qishi haqida so‘raydi. Mariya nimani o‘qishini, qaysi kursda ekanini, nima qilishi kerakligini va eng yoqtirmaydigan narsani aytadi. Tinglang va ushbu ma’lumotlarni ushlab oling. Dialogda have to va yoqtirish iboralari ham uchraydi, ularga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: Nimani o‘qiysan, Mariya? Universitetda tibbiyotni o‘qiyman. Ikkinchi kursdaman. Qiyinmi? Ha. Har oqshom o‘qishim kerak va iyunda imtihonlarim bor. Lekin men buni yaxshi ko‘raman. Darslar juda qiziqarli. Eng yomon tomoni nima? Erta turish. Birinchi darsim sakkizda boshlanadi!

scenes.title: Mariya haqida savollar
board: 4) What is the worst part for her?
scenes.say: Four questions about Maria.
scenes.say_native: Mariya haqida to‘rtta savol. Birinchi: u nimani o‘qiydi? Ikkinchi: u qaysi kursda? Uchinchi: imtihonlari qachon? To‘rtinchi: unga eng yomon tuyuladigan narsa nima? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Hamma javoblar dialogda bor, shuning uchun diqqat bilan eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Mariya haqida to‘rtta savol.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Maria studies medicine. She is in her second year. She has exams in June. The worst part is getting up early.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mariya tibbiyotni o‘qiydi, medicine. U ikkinchi kursda. Imtihonlari iyunda. Eng yomon tomoni erta turish, getting up early. Bu yerda ham -ing shakli ishlatilgan, chunki gap boshida yoki is dan keyin fe’l ot vazifasida keladi. Mariya ham ikki tomonni aytdi: qiyin, lekin yaxshi ko‘raman. Siz ham shunday gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Mariya tibbiyotni o‘qiydi. U ikkinchi kursda. Imtihonlari iyunda. Eng yomon tomoni erta turish.

scenes.title: Namuna: bir daqiqalik hikoya
board: 2) I have to ... / I'm responsible for ...
scenes.say: I'm a shop assistant. I work in a clothes shop in Tashkent. I have to wear a uniform, and I'm responsible for helping customers. I start at nine. First I clean the shop. Then I talk to customers. I finish at six. I like my job because my colleagues are friendly, but it's tiring.
scenes.say_native: Bu namuna. Shop assistant o‘zini qisqacha tasvirlayapti. Unda kasb, ish joyi, have to, responsible for, tartib bilan kun va yoqtirgan narsa hamda sababi bor. Hammasi sodda gaplar bilan aytilgan, murakkab so‘z yo‘q. Sizdan ham shuncha narsa kerak. E’tibor bering, oxirida but bilan qiyinchilik ham aytildi.
scenes.say_uz: Men sotuvchiman. Toshkentda kiyim do‘konida ishlayman. Forma kiyishim kerak va mijozlarga yordam berishga mas’ulman. To‘qqizda boshlayman. Avval do‘konni tozalayman. Keyin mijozlar bilan gaplashaman. Oltida tugataman. Ishim menga yoqadi, chunki hamkasblarim samimiy, lekin charchatadi.

scenes.title: Siz gapiring
board: My day: first, then, after that
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Describe your job or your studies. Speak for as long as you can.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Ekrandagi rejaga qarab ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida gapiring. Agar ishlamasangiz, o‘qishingiz haqida yoki orzu qilgan kasbingiz haqida gapiring. Mukammal bo‘lishi shart emas, muhimi to‘xtamasdan, baland ovozda gapirish. Hozir bu mashq qisqa, keyin uyda bir daqiqa gapirasiz. Boshlang.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingiz haqida iloji boricha ko‘proq gapiring.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
board: Did you say: I'm a ... / I study ...?
Did you use have to or responsible for?
Did you use first, then, after that?
Did you give a reason with because?
scenes.say: Check your talk. Did you use have to, responsible for, a time, and because? If yes, well done!
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizni tekshiring. Kasb yoki o‘qishingizni aytdingizmi, I’m a yoki I study. Majburiyat uchun have to yoki responsible for ishlatdingizmi? Tartib so‘zlari first, then, after that bormi? Biror narsani yoqtirish yoki yoqtirmaslikni because bilan asosladingizmi? Agar to‘rtalasi bo‘lsa, ajoyib. Bo‘lmasa, qaysi qismi yetishmaganini toping va o‘sha qismni yana gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqingizni tekshiring. Have to, responsible for, vaqt va because ishlatdingizmi? Ha bo‘lsa, barakalla!

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: I'm a ... / I work as, in, at, for
I have to ... / I'm responsible for ...
First, then, after that. at 8, in the morning
scenes.say: Today you learned jobs, study words, have to, responsible for, a typical day, and likes and dislikes.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bugun kasb va o‘qish so‘zlarini o‘rgandingiz. Work as, in, at, for farqini bildingiz. Majburiyat uchun have to, mas’uliyat uchun responsible for. Kuningizni first, then, after that bilan tartib bilan aytishni va at bilan in farqini o‘rgandingiz. Enjoy dan keyin -ing, boring bilan bored farqi, because bilan sabab ham yodingizda bo‘lsin. Siz endi ishingiz haqida gapira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun kasblar, o‘qish so‘zlari, have to, responsible for, odatiy kun va yoqtirish-yoqtirmaslik haqida o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Describe your job or studies in 1 minute
have to + responsible for + a typical day
scenes.say: Your homework: describe your job or your studies for one minute. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ishingiz yoki o‘qishingizni bir daqiqa davomida ingliz tilida tasvirlang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida bitta have to, bitta responsible for, odatiy kuningiz haqida uchta gap va bitta yoqtirgan yoki yoqtirmagan narsangiz sababi bilan bo‘lsin. Ovozingizni yozib oling va xatolaringizni toping. Keyingi darsda hozir davom etayotgan harakatni, ya’ni hozirgi davomli zamonni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: ishingiz yoki o‘qishingizni bir daqiqa tasvirlang. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Ingliz tilida 1 daqiqa davomida kasbingiz yoki o‘qishingizni tasvirlang. Matnda kamida bitta have to, bitta responsible for, odatiy kuningiz haqida uchta gap va bitta yoqtirgan yoki yoqtirmagan narsangiz sababi bilan bo‘lsin. Ovoz chiqarib gapiring va telefoningizga yozib oling; yozuvni eshitib, xatolaringizni toping.

quiz.q: She ___ a nurse. She works in a hospital.
quiz.why_uz: Kasb nomidan oldin a/an kerak: She is a nurse.
Kasbni bildirish uchun work as ishlatiladi; like kasbni bildirmaydi.

quiz.q: He ___ wear a uniform at work.
quiz.why_uz: He bilan has to: He has to wear a uniform.

quiz.q: ___ she have to work on Saturday?
quiz.why_uz: Uchinchi shaxs savolida does: Does she have to work...?

quiz.q: You can stay at home on Sunday. So you ___ work.
quiz.why_uz: Shart emas ma’nosi uchun I/you bilan don't have to.
Be responsible for: for bilan ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: She is responsible for ___ new staff.
I start work ___ half past eight.

quiz.why_uz: Enjoy dan keyin faqat -ing shakli keladi.

quiz.q: The lesson is long and I'm not interested. I'm ___.
quiz.why_uz: O‘zingizning holatingiz uchun -ed shakli: I'm bored.
